<!-- pr-reviewer: b4317ce825da967f3fb2ab69f2d8358565161889 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** One small blocker: the PR does not compile with the current main in one test file.

**What looks good**
- The default output is unchanged. With no radius, `corner_arc_radius` returns the tool radius, the value that every earlier file used. The test `no_radius_is_the_tool_radius_every_earlier_file_blends_at` compares moves and notes byte for byte. No file under `tests/golden/` and no snapshot PNG changes. `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens` pass.
- The arcs are judged as arcs. The generator calls `fillet_corners` with the existing `Legal` region (cutter-center area), and the pinning test `no_arc_turn_cuts_past_the_wall` samples the true arcs (256 points per arc), not the chord. It checks that no point comes closer to the wall (islands included) than the sharp path.
- Nonsense radii are refused by name. The command door (`sane.rs` `arc_turn_refusal`) refuses a radius that is not finite or is under 0.01 mm, even with the option off. The generator refuses a radius above the tool radius. The Trochoidal method refuses the option by name and does not ignore it.
- Undo works (`the_three_kinds_take_arc_turns_and_a_radius_through_edit_operation_and_undo`). MCP `edit_operation` reaches both fields, and the `false` leaf fix keeps the misspelling refusal.
- The stamp digest and the project file write the new values only when set. Old files do not become Stale and need no version step.
- The decision file is present. Commit type is `feat` while issue #1733 is labelled `bug`. This is a note, not a blocker.

**Results merged with main (c5ac1057d), locally**
- Trial merge: clean.
- motion: `corner_arc_radius` 7 pass; `corner_blend` 14; `corner_blend_arc` 9; `machining2d` 66; `adaptive_hsm` 1 pass (5 ignored).
- app: `arc_turn_params` 4; `corner_blend` 5; `golden_cl` 33; `mcp` 22; `operations` 119; `project_roundtrip` 73; `roughing2d` 7; `solid_law_goldens` 7. All pass.
- Mutation check (each mutation made the named tests fail; each was reverted):
  - Generator ignores the radius (always tool radius): `corners_turn_on_tangent_arcs_of_the_given_radius` and `the_adaptive_spiral_turns_on_arcs_of_the_radius_inside_the_wall` fail.
  - Upper bound (tool radius) removed: `the_door_refuses_a_radius_no_control_can_cut_by_name` fails.
  - Trochoidal refusal removed from `sane`: `arc_turns_beside_the_trochoidal_method_are_refused_by_name` fails.
  - Radius door removed from `sane`: `a_radius_no_control_can_cut_is_refused_by_name` fails.
- clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` fails to compile:
```
error[E0063]: missing field `blend_radius` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`   (crates/app/tests/opframe_picks.rs:144)
error[E0063]: missing fields `blend_radius` and `blend_turns` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`   (crates/app/tests/opframe_picks.rs:166)
```
  No other clippy error appeared (checked with `--keep-going`).

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/tests/opframe_picks.rs:144` and `:166`: this file is new on main. Its `OpParams` literals need `blend_radius: None` (and `blend_turns: false` for the Adaptive2D/Offset2D literal at :166). Merge main into the branch and add the fields.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The radius upper bound (tool radius) is checked in the generator and not at command creation, because the command door has no tool. The Prime Directive asks for early refusal. A later issue could pass the tool radius to the door.
- No MCP tool is new, but the camcraft-mcp skill does not list `blend_radius` yet. The PR body names this. Please file the follow-up issue (P5, `area:mcp`, `source:agent`) if not filed.
- UI before/after screenshots are owed for the three operation pages (see the PR body). The GUI was not opened in this review.
- ui lib suite (CWD crates/ui): 784 pass, 5 ignored.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ffb2564a2fd1b341813aa6e85577a47f2aeed1bc -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a re-review at head ffb2564a2. The earlier review was at b4317ce82. It asked for one change: the `OpParams` literals in `crates/app/tests/opframe_picks.rs` needed `blend_radius` and `blend_turns`. The new commits are a merge of main and that fix.

What looks good
- Commit ffb2564a2 adds the missing fields to the two literals in `opframe_picks.rs`. The suite now compiles and passes.
- The earlier clean findings still hold. With the option off, the radius is `None` and the tool radius is used, as before. `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens` pass without any golden change.
- The diff changes no file in `tests/golden/` and no snapshot PNG.
- No gouge or collision check is loosened. The corner law still shrinks a corner that has no room. A bad radius or the Trochoidal method with arc turns is refused by name.
- The PR touches no `build.rs`, `.github/`, script, `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/` or process file. It adds no dependency.

Results merged with main (local build, trial merge was clean, no runner used)
- Build of `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-motion` tests: ok.
- app `opframe_picks`: 4 passed. `arc_turn_params`: 4 passed. `golden_cl`: 33 passed. `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed.
- motion `corner_arc_radius`: 7 passed. `corner_blend`: 14 passed. `machining2d`: 66 passed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 787 passed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Radius bound and "Validate early". Command creation already refuses a radius that is not finite or is below 0.01 mm (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`, `ARC_RADIUS_DOOR`), and it refuses arc turns with the Trochoidal method. Only the upper bound (the tool radius) is checked in the generator (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`, `corner_arc_radius`), because the tool diameter is needed. The refusal is by name and nothing wrong is posted. This is not a blocker. It is a follow-up: a `P7` issue to check the upper bound at command creation when the tool is known. The `sane` comment already records this choice.
- Owed: nothing else found.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
